The first observation is enough for the fixture run; summarize the bounded dispatch behavior.

code_dynamic_summarizer.summary: Fixture dynamic exploration completed: the model selected repo.search through tool_dispatch, and AIR executed only the declared read-only tool under capability and budget checks.

relevant_files.reason: Defines the tool_dispatch state action as part of the AIR IR.
Executes model-selected tool dispatch through the same governed path as static tool_call.
Verifies tool_dispatch inputs, outputs, timeouts, retries, and approval-path requirements.

findings.title: Dynamic tool choice stays inside AIR contracts
findings.evidence: tool_dispatch accepts a typed {tool, input} choice, but runtime still rejects undeclared tools, mismatched capabilities, over-budget calls, schema-invalid outputs, and unsafe phase writes.

next_steps: Use this pattern to replace fixed read-only gathering stages with a bounded plan-act-observe loop.
Keep write tools out of dynamic dispatch until a module has an explicit approval path and narrow patch policy.
